```{r}
sum_stats <- read.csv("../results/stats/participants_reading_pattern_sum.csv")
df <- read.csv("../results/stats/participants_random_effects_scaled.csv")

reff_df <- df %>%
  mutate(subj_id = as.character(subj_id)) %>%
  dplyr::select(subj_id, mode, r_prev_len_c1, r_prev_len_c2, r_prev_freq_c1, r_prev_freq_c2,  r_prev_surp_c1, r_prev_surp_c2) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(r_prev_len_c1, r_prev_len_c2, r_prev_freq_c1, r_prev_freq_c2,  r_prev_surp_c1, r_prev_surp_c2),
    names_to = "contr",
    values_to = "spillover"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    effect = str_extract(contr, "(?<=r_prev_)[a-z]+"),
    contr = case_when(
      str_ends(contr, "_c1") ~ "c1",
      str_ends(contr, "_c2") ~ "c2",
      TRUE ~ contr
    )
  )


reff_local <- df %>%
  mutate(subj_id = as.character(subj_id)) %>%
  dplyr::select(subj_id, mode, r_len_c1, r_len_c2, r_freq_c1, r_freq_c2,  r_surp_c1, r_surp_c2) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(r_len_c1, r_len_c2, r_freq_c1, r_freq_c2,  r_surp_c1, r_surp_c2),
    names_to = "contr",
    values_to = "local"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    effect = str_extract(contr, "(?<=r_)[a-z]+"),
    contr = case_when(
      str_ends(contr, "_c1") ~ "c1",
      str_ends(contr, "_c2") ~ "c2",
      TRUE ~ contr
    )
  )

reff <- left_join(reff_df, reff_local, by = c("subj_id", "mode", "contr", "effect"))

sum_stats <- sum_stats %>% mutate(subj_id = as.character(subj_id)) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = measures,
    values_from = mean_value
  ) %>%
  mutate(mode = if_else(mode == "et_indico", "indicos", mode))

subj_df <- left_join(reff, sum_stats, by = c("mode", "subj_id", "contr")) %>%
  rename(Spillover = spillover,
         Contrast = contr) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(local, skip, FPReg),
    names_to = "measures",
    values_to = "Rate"
  ) %>%
  mutate(mode = factor(mode,
                        levels = c("indicos", "potec", "onestop", "geconl", "gecozh", "hkc"),
                        labels = c("InDiCo", "PoTeC", "OneStop", "GECO-NL", "GECO-ZH", "HKC")),
         measures = factor(measures,
                           levels = c("skip", "FPReg", "local"),
                           labels = c("Skip Rate", "Regression Rate", "Local Effect")),
         effect = factor(effect, 
                         levels = c("len", "freq", "surp"),
                         labels = c("Word Length", "Lexical Frequency", "Surprisal"))
         ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  drop_na()
View(subj_df)
```


```{r}
model_prefix <- paste0("../models/behavior/")
fnames <- list.files(path=model_prefix)
print(fnames)

# read in models, get random effects for each participant, store in a df.
df <- data.frame()
for (f in fnames) {
    m <- read_rds(paste0(model_prefix, "/", f))
    mode <- strsplit(f, "_")[[1]][1]
    effect <- strsplit(f, "_")[[1]][2]
    measures <- strsplit(f, "_")[[1]][4]
    contr <- strsplit(f, "_")[[1]][5]
    sum <- summary(m, pars = c("rho"))$summary
    rho_stats <- sum["rho", c("mean", "2.5%", "97.5%")]
    row <- tibble(
    mode = mode,
    effect = effect,
    measures = measures,
    contr = contr,
    rho_mean = rho_stats["mean"],
    rho_lower = rho_stats["2.5%"],
    rho_upper = rho_stats["97.5%"]
  )
  df <- rbind(df, row)
}

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    contr = case_when(
      contr == "c1.rds" ~ "c1",
      contr == "c2.rds" ~ "c2",
      TRUE ~ "all"
    ),
    measures = str_remove(measures, "\\.rds$")
  )

model_prefix <- paste0("../models/cor_scaled/")
fnames <- list.files(path=model_prefix)
print(fnames)

# read in models, get random effects for each participant, store in a df.
local_df <- data.frame()
for (f in fnames) {
    m <- read_rds(paste0(model_prefix, "/", f))
    mode <- strsplit(f, "_")[[1]][1]
    posterior_correlations <- as_draws_df(m) %>%
      mutate(
        mode = mode,
        measures = "Local Effect",
        cor_c1_len = `cor_subj_id__c1:len__c1:prev_len`,
        cor_c2_len = `cor_subj_id__c2:len__c2:prev_len`,
        cor_c1_freq = `cor_subj_id__c1:freq__c1:prev_freq`,
        cor_c2_freq = `cor_subj_id__c2:freq__c2:prev_freq`,
        cor_c1_surp = `cor_subj_id__c1:surp__c1:prev_surp`,
        cor_c2_surp = `cor_subj_id__c2:surp__c2:prev_surp`,
        ) %>%
      dplyr::select(mode, measures, cor_c1_len, cor_c2_len, cor_c1_freq, cor_c2_freq, cor_c1_surp, cor_c2_surp)
  local_df <- bind_rows(local_df, posterior_correlations)
}

local_sum <- local_df %>%
  group_by(mode, measures) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      .cols = c(cor_c1_len, cor_c2_len, cor_c1_freq, cor_c2_freq, cor_c1_surp, cor_c2_surp),
      .fns = list(
        mean = mean,
        lower = ~ quantile(.x, 0.025),
        upper = ~ quantile(.x, 0.975)
        # lower = ~ hdi(.x, credMass = 0.95)[1],
        # upper = ~ hdi(.x, credMass = 0.95)[2]
      ),
      .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% pivot_longer(
    cols = 3:20,
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    parts = str_split(variable, "_", simplify = TRUE),
    contr = parts[, 2],
    effect = parts[, 3],
    stat = paste0("rho_", parts[, 4])
  ) %>%
  mutate(mode = factor(mode,
                        levels = c("indicos", "potec", "onestop", "geconl", "gecozh", "hkc"),
                        labels = c("InDiCo", "PoTeC", "OneStop", "GECO-NL", "GECO-ZH", "HKC")),
         effect = factor(effect, 
                         levels = c("len", "freq", "surp"),
                         labels = c("Word Length", "Lexical Frequency", "Surprisal"))) %>%
  dplyr::select(mode, measures, contr, effect, stat, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = stat,
    values_from = value
  )
  
behavior <- bind_rows(df, local_sum) %>%
    mutate(mode = factor(mode,
                        levels = c("InDiCo", "PoTeC", "OneStop", "GECO-NL", "GECO-ZH", "HKC"),
                        labels = c("InDiCo", "PoTeC", "OneStop", "GECO-NL", "GECO-ZH", "HKC")),
         measures = factor(measures,
                           levels = c("Skip Rate", "Regression Rate", "Local Effect"),
                           labels = c("Skip Rate", "Regression Rate", "Local Effect")),
         effect = factor(effect, 
                         levels = c("Word Length", "Lexical Frequency", "Surprisal"),
                         labels = c("Word Length", "Lexical Frequency", "Surprisal"))
         ) %>%
  arrange(mode, measures, effect, contr) %>% 
  rename(Contrast = contr) %>%
  mutate(
    annotation = sprintf(
      "hat(rho) == %.2f*\"[\"*%.2f*\",\" ~ %.2f*\"]\"",
      rho_mean, rho_lower, rho_upper
    ),
    x_pos = ifelse(Contrast == "c1", -Inf, Inf),
    y_pos = ifelse(Contrast == "c1", Inf, -Inf),
    hjust_val = ifelse(Contrast == "c1", -0.05, 1.05),
    vjust_val = ifelse(Contrast == "c1", 1.1, -0.1)
  ) %>% filter(Contrast != "all")
  
View(behavior)
write_csv(behavior, "../results/stats/behavior_cor_spillover_skip_regress_bayesian_scaled.csv")
```

```{r}
label_list <- list(
  "InDiCo"   = c("c1" = "Session 1",  "c2" = "Session 2"),
  "PoTeC"    = c("c1" = "In-Dom.",         "c2" = "Out-Dom."),

)

label_list["InDiCo"]
```

```{r Plot spillover skip regression correlation}
for (mod in modes) {
  behavior_tmp <- behavior %>% 
    filter(!measures %in% c("Local Effect")) %>%
    filter(mode == mod)
  
  p <- subj_df %>%
    filter(!measures %in% c("Local Effect")) %>%
    filter(mode == mod) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = Spillover, y = Rate, color = Contrast)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 0.8) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, linewidth = 0.8) +
    facet_grid(measures ~ effect, scales = "free") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.15, 0.15))) +
    geom_text(
      data = behavior_tmp,
      aes(x = x_pos, y = y_pos, label = annotation, color = Contrast,
          hjust = hjust_val, vjust = vjust_val),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 3,
      parse = TRUE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("c1" = "#3C64FF", "c2" = "#E6281E"),
      labels = label_list[[mod]]
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 4) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(title = mod)) +
    labs(
      x = "Spillover Effect Size",
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_light(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      strip.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    )

  # Save the plot for this mode
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0("../visualization/paper/behav_cor/", mod, "_skip_regr_spillover_cor.pdf"),
    plot = p,
    width = 8,
    height = 4.5,
    dpi = 300
  )
}
```

```{r archived chunk, eval=FALSE}
subj_sum <- subj_df %>%
  dplyr::select(subj_id, mode, Contrast, Spillover, effect) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(mode, Contrast, effect) %>%
  summarize(
    mean = mean(Spillover),
    sd = sd(Spillover),
    n = n()
  )

ttest_pvals <- subj_df %>%
  dplyr::select(subj_id, mode, Contrast, Spillover, effect) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(mode, effect) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(
    data_wide = map(data, ~ pivot_wider(.x, names_from = Contrast, values_from = Spillover)),
    t_test = map(data_wide, ~ t.test(.x[[2]], .x[[3]], paired = TRUE)),  # t test between c1 and c2
    p_value = map_dbl(t_test, ~ .x$p.value)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(mode, effect, p_value)

subj_sum_combined <- subj_sum %>%
  left_join(ttest_pvals, by = c("mode", "effect"))
View(subj_sum_combined)

write_csv(subj_sum_combined, "../results/stats/subj_sum_stats.csv")
```

```{r Plot spillover local correlation for all datasets}
modes   <- c("InDiCo", "PoTeC", "OneStop", "GECO-NL", "GECO-ZH", "HKC")
effects <- c("Word Length", "Lexical Frequency", "Surprisal")

df_plot <- subj_df %>%
  filter(measures %in% "Local Effect") %>%
  mutate(
    mode   = factor(mode,   levels = modes),
    effect = factor(effect, levels = effects)
  )

behavior_ann <- behavior %>%
  filter(measures %in% "Local Effect") %>%
  mutate(
    mode   = factor(mode,   levels = modes),
    effect = factor(effect, levels = effects)
  )

p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(Spillover, Rate, color = Contrast)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(
    data = behavior_ann,
    aes(x = x_pos, y = y_pos, label = annotation, color = Contrast,
        hjust = hjust_val, vjust = vjust_val),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3, parse = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("c1" = "#3C64FF", "c2" = "#E6281E")) +
  scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 4) +
  labs(x = "Spillover Effect Size", y = NULL) +
  ggh4x::facet_grid2(
    rows = vars(mode),
    cols = vars(effect),
    scales = "free_x",
    independent = "x"  # per-panel x-axes
  ) +
  theme_light(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "none",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text.x     = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),  # keep EFFECT
    strip.text.y     = element_blank(),                           # hide MODE
    panel.border     = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
    panel.grid       = element_blank()
  )

ggsave(
  filename = "../visualization/paper/behav_cor/ALL_local_spillover_cor.pdf",
  plot = p,
  width = 6,
  height = 12,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r Plot Local effects by context breakdown}
effects <- c("Word Length", "Lexical Frequency", "Surprisal")

for (mod in c("InDiCo", "PoTeC")) {
  for (eff in effects) {
    plot_df <- subj_df %>%
      filter(mode == mod, measures == "Local Effect") %>%
      mutate(x_pos = ifelse(Contrast == "c1", 1, 2)) %>%
      filter(effect == eff)
    axis_labels <- unname(label_list[[mod]][c("c1", "c2")])
    p <- ggplot() +
      # Blue half-eye (c1)
      stat_halfeye(
        data = plot_df %>% filter(Contrast == "c1"),
        aes(x = x_pos - 0.85, y = Rate, fill = Contrast),
        show.legend = FALSE, 
        adjust = 0.5,
        side = "left",
        alpha = 0.6,
        width = 0.8,
        justification = 0,
        .width = 0,
        point_colour = NA
      ) +
      # Red half-eye (c2)
      stat_halfeye(
        data = plot_df %>% filter(Contrast == "c2"),
        aes(x = x_pos + 0.15, y = Rate, fill = Contrast),
        show.legend = FALSE, 
        adjust = 0.5,
        side = "right",
        alpha = 0.6,
        width = 0.8,
        justification = 0,
        .width = 0,
        point_colour = NA
      ) +
      # Boxplots
      geom_boxplot(
        data = plot_df %>% filter(Contrast == "c1"),
        aes(x = x_pos - 0.3, y = Rate, fill = Contrast),
        width = 0.2,
        alpha = 0.5,
        outlier.shape = NA
      ) +
      geom_boxplot(
        data = plot_df %>% filter(Contrast == "c2"),
        aes(x = x_pos + 0.3, y = Rate, fill = Contrast),
        width = 0.2,
        alpha = 0.5,
        outlier.shape = NA
      ) +
      # Paired lines
      geom_line(
        data = plot_df,
        aes(x = x_pos, y = Rate, group = subj_id),
        color = "gray60",
        size = 0.3,
        alpha = 0.5
      ) +
      # Jittered points
      geom_jitter(
        data = plot_df,
        aes(x = x_pos, y = Rate, color = Contrast),
        width = 0.08,
        size = 1,
        alpha = 0.6
      ) +
      facet_wrap(~effect, scales = "free") +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 2),labels = axis_labels) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("c1" = "#3C64FF", "c2" = "#E6281E")) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("c1" = "#3C64FF", "c2" = "#E6281E"),labels = label_list[[mod]]) +
      guides(color = guide_legend(title = mod)) +
      labs(x = "", y = "Local Effect") +
      theme_light(base_size = 13) +
      theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 13),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black"),
        axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "black")
      )
ggsave(filename = sprintf("../visualization/paper/indiv_breakdown/Local/%s_Local_Effect_%s.pdf", mod, gsub(" ", "_", eff)), plot = p, width = 3, height = 3, dpi = 300)
  }
}
```

```{r Plot Skip Regression by context breakdown}
effects <- c("Word Length", "Lexical Frequency", "Surprisal")
modes   <- c("InDiCo", "PoTeC")

for (mod in modes) {
  for (eff in effects) {
    plot_df <- subj_df %>%
      dplyr::select(-measures, -Rate, -subj) %>%
      distinct() %>%
      filter(
        mode == mod,
        effect == eff
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        x_pos = if_else(Contrast == "c1", 1, 2)
      )

    # Use labels stored for the current mode
    axis_labels <- unname(label_list[[mod]][c("c1", "c2")])
    p <- ggplot() +
      # Half-eye distribution for c1
      stat_halfeye(
        data = plot_df %>% filter(Contrast == "c1"),
        aes(
          x = x_pos - 0.85,
          y = Spillover,
          fill = Contrast
        ),
        show.legend = FALSE,
        adjust = 0.5,
        side = "left",
        alpha = 0.6,
        width = 0.8,
        justification = 0,
        .width = 0,
        point_colour = NA
      ) +

      # Half-eye distribution for c2
      stat_halfeye(
        data = plot_df %>% filter(Contrast == "c2"),
        aes(
          x = x_pos + 0.15,
          y = Spillover,
          fill = Contrast
        ),
        show.legend = FALSE,
        adjust = 0.5,
        side = "right",
        alpha = 0.6,
        width = 0.8,
        justification = 0,
        .width = 0,
        point_colour = NA
      ) +

      # Boxplot for c1
      geom_boxplot(
        data = plot_df %>% filter(Contrast == "c1"),
        aes(
          x = x_pos - 0.3,
          y = Spillover,
          fill = Contrast
        ),
        width = 0.2,
        alpha = 0.5,
        outlier.shape = NA,
        show.legend = FALSE
      ) +

      # Boxplot for c2
      geom_boxplot(
        data = plot_df %>% filter(Contrast == "c2"),
        aes(
          x = x_pos + 0.3,
          y = Spillover,
          fill = Contrast
        ),
        width = 0.2,
        alpha = 0.5,
        outlier.shape = NA,
        show.legend = FALSE
      ) +

      # Lines connecting observations from the same participant
      geom_line(
        data = plot_df,
        aes(
          x = x_pos,
          y = Spillover,
          group = subj_id
        ),
        color = "gray60",
        linewidth = 0.3,
        alpha = 0.5
      ) +

      # Individual observations
      geom_jitter(
        data = plot_df,
        aes(
          x = x_pos,
          y = Spillover,
          color = Contrast
        ),
        width = 0.08,
        height = 0,
        size = 0.6,
        alpha = 0.4,
        show.legend = FALSE
      ) +

      scale_x_continuous(
        breaks = c(1, 2),
        labels = axis_labels
      ) +

      scale_fill_manual(
        values = c(
          "c1" = "#3C64FF",
          "c2" = "#E6281E"
        )
      ) +

      scale_color_manual(
        values = c(
          "c1" = "#3C64FF",
          "c2" = "#E6281E"
        )
      ) +

      labs(
        x = NULL,
        y = paste(eff, "Spillover")
      ) +

      theme_light(base_size = 13) +

      theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 13),
        axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black"),   # darker tick labels
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
      )
    # Convert spaces to underscores for safe filenames
    eff_filename <- gsub("\\s+", "_", eff)
    ggsave(filename = file.path("../visualization/paper/indiv_breakdown/Spillover", paste0(mod, "_", eff_filename, "_spillover_indiv.pdf")), plot = p, width = 3, height = 2.7, dpi = 300)
  }
  }
```
